purpose: Represent positive and negative controls for source-to-LEGO translation evaluation without confusing synthetic mismatches with real design decisions.
policies: Synthetic negative controls must never be ingested as observed LEGO design decisions.
Positive controls preserve the original paired identity.
Global negatives pair different identities deterministically.
Hard-group negatives pair different identities sharing a source series/set when possible.
Controls test identity/source fidelity; they do not independently label style quality.
